item.title: Trump lawyers agree to unseal evidence presented for Georgia election raid
item.description: President Donald Trump's lawyers have agreed to unseal evidence they presented to secure a search warrant used to justify a recent raid at an election office in Georgia, according to a new court order. item.description: An artists' collective led an "ICE Out" protest inside Levi's Stadium on Sunday during Super Bowl LX. item.title: Trump melts down over Super Bowl halftime show: 'One of the worst ever!'
item.description: President Donald Trump melted down on Truth Social on Sunday over the halftime show for Super Bowl LX.
